title: Makah language - Wikipedia
text: December 29, 2025 - Makah is a Wakashan language spoken by the Makah. Makah has not been spoken as a first language since 2002, when its last fluent native speaker died. However, it survives as a second language, and the Makah tribe is attempting to revive the language, including through preschool classes.

text: Makah is a dormant language of the United States. It belongs to the Wakashan language family. The language is no longer used as a first language by any remaining members of the ethnic community. It is not known to be taught in schools.
